name: Tasks
description: Lists and reminders that sync between your devices and can be shared.

actions.name: tasks.list_lists
actions.description: The lists (with the number of open tasks in each) and the smart lists Today, Scheduled, Flagged, All and Completed.

actions.name: tasks.create_list
actions.description: Create a list. Colors: red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, indigo, purple, pink, brown, gray.

actions.name: tasks.update_list
actions.description: Rename a list or change its color or icon. The list is an id or a name.

actions.name: tasks.delete_list
actions.description: Delete a list with all its tasks from every device (for the owner), or leave a list someone shared with you.

actions.name: tasks.list
actions.description: Tasks of a list, or of a smart list (smart: today, scheduled, flagged, all, completed). Completed tasks are left out of a list unless completed is true.

actions.name: tasks.add
actions.description: Add a task. Pass title and fields, or quick: a line such as "call mom tomorrow 9am #family" (dates: today, tomorrow, next fri, in 3 days, nov 25, 2026-12-01, at 14:30, every monday; ! flags). parent makes a subtask.

actions.name: tasks.update
actions.description: Change a task's title, notes, due date (empty clears it and the time), time, flag or repeat.

actions.name: tasks.complete
actions.description: Complete a task (done false reopens it). Completing a recurring task schedules the next one.

actions.name: tasks.delete
actions.description: Delete tasks (and their subtasks) from all devices.

actions.name: tasks.move
actions.description: Move a task to another list (list), or to a position in its list (before or after another task's id).

actions.name: tasks.search
actions.description: Find tasks by words in the title, notes or list name (all words must match), completed ones included.

actions.name: tasks.today
actions.description: What is due today, plus what is overdue.

actions.name: tasks.share
actions.description: Share a list you own with a person (id or name) as read or write, or stop sharing (mode none).

actions.name: tasks.export
actions.description: A list as a Markdown checklist.

actions.name: tasks.import
actions.description: Add the tasks of a Markdown checklist to a list (list), or to a new list named after its heading (or name).

actions.name: tasks.snapshot
actions.description: Everything the UI shows in one call: today's date, all lists with counts and all tasks.
